title: Gimme Some Truth
lyrics_plain:
I'm sick and tired of hearing things
from uptight, short sighted,
narrow minded hypocritics.
All I want is the truth!
Just gimme some truth!
I've had enough of reading things
by neurotic, psychotic, pig headed politicians.
All I want is the truth!
Just gimme some truth!
No short haired, yellow bellied,
son of tricky dicky
is gonna mother hubbard
soft soap me with just
a pocketful of hope.
Money for dope!
Money for rope!
No short haired, yellow bellied,
son of tricky dicky
is gonna mother hubbard
soft soap me with just
a pocketful of soap.
Money for dope!
I'm sick to death of seeing things
from tight lipped, condescending,
mama's little chauvinists.
All I want is the truth!
Just gimme some truth!
Now I've had enough of watching scenes
of schizophrenic, ego centric,
paranoiac, prima donnas.
All I want is the truth!
Now, gimme some truth!
Gimme some truth!
No short haired, yellow bellied,
son of tricky dicky
is gonna mother hubbard
soft soap me
with just a pocketful of soap.
It's money for dope!
Money for rope!
It's money for dope!
Money for rope!
It's money for dope!
